description: Source file for diff-related functions in a Git implementation, including diffing work trees, index, and merge bases.

methods.name: int check_removed(const struct cache_entry * ce,struct stat * st)
methods.description: Checks if a work tree entity has been removed, returns 1 if removed, 0 if still exists, negative on error.

methods.name: int match_stat_with_submodule(struct diff_options * diffopt,const struct cache_entry * ce,struct stat * st,unsigned ce_option,unsigned * dirty_submodule)
methods.description: Determines if a file has changed, considering submodules, for diffing purposes.

methods.name: void run_diff_files(struct rev_info * revs,unsigned int option)
methods.description: Performs diffing of work tree files, printing differences.

methods.name: void diff_index_show_file(struct rev_info * revs,const char * prefix,const struct cache_entry * ce,const struct object_id * oid,int oid_valid,unsigned int mode,unsigned dirty_submodule)
methods.description: Displays diff for a file either added or removed.

methods.name: int get_stat_data(const struct cache_entry * ce,const struct object_id ** oidp,unsigned int * modep,int cached,int match_missing,unsigned * dirty_submodule,struct diff_options * diffopt)
methods.description: Retrieves file metadata and status information for diffing.

methods.name: void show_new_file(struct rev_info * revs,const struct cache_entry * new_file,int cached,int match_missing)
methods.description: Shows diff for new files added.

methods.name: int show_modified(struct rev_info * revs,const struct cache_entry * old_entry,const struct cache_entry * new_entry,int report_missing,int cached,int match_missing)
methods.description: Displays modifications between old and new cache entries.

methods.name: void do_oneway_diff(struct unpack_trees_options * o,const struct cache_entry * idx,const struct cache_entry * tree)
methods.description: Handles diffing between index and tree entries, considering path matching and conflicts.

methods.name: int diff_cache(struct rev_info * revs,const struct object_id * tree_oid,const char * tree_name,int cached)
methods.description: Diffs a given tree object against the current index, initializing necessary structures.

methods.name: void diff_get_merge_base(const struct rev_info * revs,struct object_id * mb)
methods.description: Calculates the merge base for a set of revisions.

methods.name: void run_diff_index(struct rev_info * revs,unsigned int option)
methods.description: Executes diffing between the current index and a specified revision or merge base.

methods.name: int do_diff_cache(const struct object_id * tree_oid,struct diff_options * opt)
methods.description: Wrapper function to perform diffing of a specific tree object.

methods.name: int index_differs_from(struct repository * r,const char * def,const struct diff_flags * flags,int ita_invisible_in_index)
methods.description: Checks if the index differs from a specified revision with given flags.

methods.name: const char * idiff_prefix_cb(struct diff_options * opt UNUSED,void * data)
methods.description: Callback for prefixing diff output with indentation.

methods.name: void show_interdiff(const struct object_id * oid1,const struct object_id * oid2,int indent,struct diff_options * diffopt)
methods.description: Shows an interdiff between two objects with specified indentation.

methods.name: int oneway_diff(const struct cache_entry * const * src,struct unpack_trees_options * o)
